Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Caucasus

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Caucasus
public class Caucasus extends Object
Caucasus-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_CAUCASUS section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x16.
